shared_dependency_clusters.risk: All three share same-model generation and same-model/same-team evaluation. Should be counted as at most one weak internal-consistency data point, not three independent confirmations.

All five reuse the same GPT/Claude/Gemini provider triad, overlapping packet and artifact-family designs, and (for E7-E9) the same evolving Comparator tooling family. Cross-model convergence claims (H003) drawing on multiple of these should not be treated as independently replicated across five studies; provider selection and instrument lineage are shared confounds.
Same authoring agent across both; E14 is a successor pass by the same evaluator, not an independent second opinion.
